intent: Choose a brand colour by seeing type and a precise hex value on the colour itself.

layout.direction: A split colour study: a 192px colour field with oversized serif Aa and a hex caption, over a neutral swatch tray. Swatches wrap at narrow widths.
layout.container: A full-width card capped at 28rem. Keep the specimen in a 192px-high area with 32px padding and the named palette below with 24px padding.

typography.heading: 18px medium-weight colour label
typography.specimen: 96px serif Aa and 12px uppercase mono hex caption

motion.entrance: A single opacity and 8px rise over 320ms.
motion.interaction: 200ms specimen colour transitions and 150ms press feedback. No ambient loops.
motion.reduced: Settle the entrance and specimen colour immediately on reduced motion, including changes while mounted. Preserve picker focus and selection.

responsive.rules: Wrap long copy; stack secondary details inside narrow containers; keep any horizontal scrolling local and keyboard accessible.

accessibility: Use native buttons and form controls with visible 2px focus rings.
Provide labels, meaningful states and polite feedback where actions update content.
Keep IDs instance-scoped with useId; support multiple instances and empty custom data.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; no automatic action or navigation.

content.defaults: Use the realistic default content from the source; expose content and collection inputs as typed props.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Named six-digit hex colours; malformed values are excluded.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled six-digit hex colour. Without onChange, editing is read-only.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink palette; the demo stage follows the chosen theme.

avoid: Remote images, fake network success or hidden external dependencies.
Decorative status badges, gradients as filler, low-contrast text.
Unlabelled controls, hover-only functionality, overflow at 320px.
contract: Accept six-digit hex strings only; filter malformed presets and render Chalk for an invalid selected value.
Keep presets as labelled pressed buttons in a named group; empty presets retain the custom colour picker.
Use the higher-contrast choice of pure black or white for both the specimen and its small hex caption.

The host owns controlled values. A missing writer or disabled prop makes both preset and custom editing unavailable. Do not emit a change for the already selected colour. Selecting the visual Chalk fallback for an invalid stored value still proposes the repair.
